"""Exercise installed Hermes discovery/readback; owned empty profile only."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path[:0] = json.loads(os.environ["OMNIS_QA_NATIVE_PATHS"])
root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
owned = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
from hermes_constants import get_hermes_home
assert get_hermes_home().resolve() == owned / "profile"
assert not (get_hermes_home() / ".env").exists()
from hermes_cli.config import set_config_value, load_config_readonly
set_config_value("skills.trusted_project_dirs", json.dumps([str(root)]))
assert load_config_readonly()["skills"]["trusted_project_dirs"] == [str(root)]
from agent.prompt_builder import build_context_files_prompt, build_skills_system_prompt
from agent.skill_utils import parse_frontmatter
from tools.skills_guard import scan_skill_cached
from tools.skills_tool import find_all_skills, skill_view

expected = {p.parent.name: p for p in (root / ".hermes/skills").glob("*/SKILL.md")}
assert len(expected) == 13
listed = {s["name"] for s in find_all_skills()}
assert listed == set(expected), {"missing": sorted(set(expected) - listed), "extra": sorted(listed - set(expected))}
agents = (root / "AGENTS.md").read_text()
for cwd in (root, root / "tests/documentation"):
    context = build_context_files_prompt(cwd=str(cwd), skip_soul=True)
    # Native _read_context_file strips only surrounding whitespace.
    assert agents.strip() and agents.strip() in context and "[BLOCKED:" not in context, str(cwd)
index = build_skills_system_prompt()
assert all(name in index for name in expected)
rows = []
for name, path in sorted(expected.items()):
    original = path.read_bytes()
    metadata, _ = parse_frontmatter(original.decode("utf-8"))
    assert not metadata.get("deps") and not metadata.get("required_environment_variables")
    assert not metadata.get("required_credential_files")
    result = json.loads(skill_view(name, preprocess=False))
    assert result.get("success") is True, name
    assert Path(result["skill_dir"]).resolve() == path.parent.resolve()
    assert result["content"].encode("utf-8") == original, name
    linked = [item for group in (result.get("linked_files") or {}).values() for item in group]
    for relative in linked:
        loaded = json.loads(skill_view(name, file_path=relative, preprocess=False))
        assert loaded.get("success") is True, (name, relative)
    scan, _ = scan_skill_cached(path.parent, source="project-local", cache_dir=get_hermes_home() / "cache/project_skill_scans")
    assert scan.verdict != "dangerous", name
    assert path.read_bytes() == original, name
    rows.append({"name": name, "version": metadata["version"], "path": str(path.relative_to(root)),
                 "sha256": hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(), "native_read": True,
                 "scanner_verdict": scan.verdict, "linked_files_read": len(linked),
                 "findings": [{"pattern_id": f.pattern_id, "severity": f.severity, "file": f.file, "line": f.line} for f in scan.findings]})
escape = "../omnis-review-qa/SKILL.md"
assert (expected["omnis-delivery"].parent / escape).is_file()
refusal = json.loads(skill_view("omnis-delivery", file_path=escape, preprocess=False))
assert refusal.get("success") is False and refusal.get("error") == "Path traversal ('..') is not allowed."
report = {"status": "PASS", "scope": "fresh installed Hermes project discovery/index/context/skill and linked-file reads; isolated empty profile",
          "count": len(rows), "skills": rows, "agents_sha256": hashlib.sha256(agents.encode()).hexdigest(),
          "agents_loaded_untruncated_root_and_subdir": True, "linked_path_escape_refused": True,
          "product_runtime_exercised": False, "inference_executed": False,
          "limits": "No global SOUL/config edits; explicit disposable trust setting. Does not certify future model compliance or refresh this TUI's cached prompt."}
(owned / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "skills"}, ensure_ascii=False))
